subject: Demo recap + proposed evaluation sprint for SableCore
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@sablecore.io>, sales@sablecore.io
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed evaluation sprint for SableCore

Hi Olivia / SableCore team,

Thanks again for taking the demo today — really appreciated the practical questions. Per our call, below is a short recap and a proposed 3-week evaluation sprint so your engineering and product teams can validate latency, throughput, and integration surface area with minimal lift.

Quick recap from the demo:
- Core ask: build a plugin that surfaces model-assisted recommendations in SableCore Console with <150ms median latency for single-shot lookups and safe redaction for PII.
- Primary success metrics: 1) median latency <= 150ms, 2) per-call cost <= $0.030 (token-normalized), 3) false-positive rate on PII redaction < 1.5% on your sample set.

Proposed evaluation sprint (3 weeks):
1) Week 0 (kickoff & access) — 2 business days
   - Deliverables: test tenant + temporary API keys, demo recording, and access to the sample dataset you shared.
   - Owners: Tessa (coord), Ben (SE for infra/throughput).
2) Week 1 (integration & baseline) — 5 business days
   - Redwood provides a lightweight integration guide + example connector. Run baseline tests against your representative queries; measure latency and token usage.
   - Owners: SableCore eng + Ben.
3) Week 2 (workloads & tuning) — 5 business days
   - Tune batching, KV cache, and model variant. Produce a short report with recommended quantization/profile changes.
4) Week 3 (acceptance & decision) — 5 business days
   - Final acceptance run, share results vs success criteria; review next-step commercial options.

Attachments: sample POC one-pager and scope matrix attached (sablecore-poc-proposal.pdf). Full demo recording link included below.

Asks / next steps for you:
- Confirm the primary technical contact (who will run integration tests) and the procurement contact (for an NDA or MSA if needed).
- Does the 3-week timeline look feasible from your side? If you need a compressed 2-week window, we can scope down the tuning phase.

If this looks good I’ll send a calendar invite for a short kickoff (30–45m) and spin up the temporary test tenant.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0132

--

Hi Tessa — thanks for the clear summary. High level: we like the proposed focus and want to proceed but have two asks before kickoff:

1) Procurement/Legal: our procurement team needs to review a standard MSA + reciprocal data handling terms. I’ve looped procurement and Marcus (our CTO) on this thread.
2) Timeline: the proposed 3-week sprint is OK, but our SRE lead is on holiday the week of May 10. Would you be able to shift the baseline to start May 17 instead (kickoff May 17)? That gives us the right coverage.

Also: can you share a short SOC 2 / security posture note so our security reviewer has a reference?

Assignees from our side: Marcus will own technical sign-off, procurement will coordinate contracts, and I’ll own product acceptance criteria.

Olivia Chen
